brief.en: Hurts zombies in an area when attacked
brief.zh: 受伤时对范围内僵尸造成伤害

description.en: Lychees damage zombies in an area around it when attacked.
description.zh: 荔枝在受到伤害时对范围内的僵尸造成伤害。

chat.en: Lychee knows gratitude, but bears any of his enemies a grudge. He always keep those in mind, "Tit for tat is fair play. Receive drips of water when in need, and return the kindness with a spring."
chat.zh: 荔枝懂得感恩，当然也会记仇，心中总是默念：“人不犯我，我不犯人；滴水之恩，涌泉相报！”

text.en: damages all zombies in a 3x3 area when attacked
text.zh: 受到伤害时对 3x3 范围内所有僵尸造成伤害
